title: Vehicle Body 1DOF Longitudinal
text: Two-axle vehicle in forward and reverse motion, 8 inputs, 4 outputs; {External forces} sets the fExt input port, {External moments} sets the mExt input port, {Air temperature} sets the airTemp input port, {Wind X,Y,Z components} sets the windXYZ input port, {Number of wheels on front axle, NF} sets the front wheel count, {Number of wheels on rear axle, NR} sets the rear wheel count, {Mass, m} sets the vehicle mass, {Horizontal distance from CG to front axle, a} sets the front axle distance, {Horizontal distance from CG to rear axle, b} sets the rear axle distance, {CG height above axles, h} sets the height .35, {Longitudinal drag coefficient, Cd} sets the drag .3, {Longitudinal lift coefficient, Cl} sets the lift, {Longitudinal drag pitch moment, Cpm} sets the pitch drag, {Frontal area, Af} sets the area, {Initial position, x_o} sets the position, {Initial velocity, xdot_o} sets the velocity, {Absolute air pressure, Pabs} sets the pressure, {Air temperature, T} sets the ambient air temperature and {Gravitational acceleration, g} sets the gravity. Values come from the instance.
